evals.prompt: Adopt the harness in an empty greenfield repository. What must be proven before any work starts?
evals.expected_output: do-harness init scaffolds the workspace plus a minimal rust crate, then do-harness verify must actually execute every sensor and exit 0 — the green path is computed, never assumed. A subsequently failing sensor records its error signature for the fail-fast lifecycle.

evals.prompt: Before starting repository work, obtain and verify latest origin/main. Prove that remote tracking advances while the checked-out HEAD remains preserved.
evals.expected_output: The latest-main helper queries the remote, fetches commit B to refs/remotes/origin/main, and leaves checked-out HEAD at commit A.

evals.prompt: Attempt to refresh latest origin/main outside a git worktree. What happens?
evals.expected_output: The helper exits with code 2, emits no success commit SHA to stdout, reports not inside a git work tree on stderr, and touches no workspace.
assertions: contains:outside_git.err|not inside a git work tree
